coverage.title: ATOMIC 🔥: A new open-source Atomic Agent Desktop app is now available for macOS, Windows, and Linux! The app lets users run open models like Qwen and Gemma locally. The app is free, requires no account, and connects to a cloud model only when selected. > A setup wizard checks https://t.co/hUGJP5YLBw https://t.co/UowTsHb9vv
